verdict.rationale: Docs confirm out-of-the-box OpenAI model support with a pluggable Model interface (e.g., OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL env var to switch models), and the GitHub README explicitly states the SDK is provider-agnostic, supporting OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions and 100+ other LLMs, implying swapping providers without rewriting agent logic. No community evidence contradicts this claim.
